title: Briefing — Saturday, November 28
summary: Michael Nielsen takes down his deep learning textbook over frontier AI safety concerns; Neuroimaging reveals covert consciousness in comatose ICU patients, challenging traditional end-of-life protocols; Systemic Screening Gaps Leave Perinatal Eating Disorders Largely Undiagnosed and Untreated; Sodium-ion batteries emerge as cheap, supply-secure alternatives for grid energy storage; A Swedish clinic offers formal reassessment and removal of ADHD and autism diagnoses
